text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Shhh... Don't say a word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I just came to a realization. Gold Ship
only acts
out the more you react to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Which means, I must simply ignore her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But, whether you react or not, there's no
telling
what Gold Ship has up her
sleeve... And I think I
need to tell this to
Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...No, you needn't worry. This is a match between me and her.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bzz, bzzt, bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look, I found a Golshi cicada!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the—I've just received a suspicious

transmission! It's an urgent message from
Planet
Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way... there's an all-you-can-eat
melon parfait
event?! And it comes with
a rare photo of Mac
munching on a mont
blanc?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen, you can't be serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen plans to stick by her
words.
She's silent in the face of Gold
Ship's antics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I w-won't be deceived by your crocodile
tears!
Certainly, this is just a trap.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Hold on a minute! What
happened to that
obnoxiously cheery
demeanor of yours?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I can't believe this! What
happened to that
obnoxiously cheery
demeanor of yours?!
choice_data_list: 気を強く持て！あれは罠だ！
気を強く持って！あれは罠だよ！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: 気を強く持て！あれは罠だ！
気を強く持って！あれは罠だよ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nahahaha! Why yes, this was a trap, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You reacted, so you lose! Now you have
to play
nice with me for the rest of the
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come now. You two are the only ones
that come
when I cry wolf y'know? All
right, then, the plan
for today is...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hm? Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Of course not! It takes passion to
come up
with these things! True heart
and passion!
choice_data_list: もしかして構い方を迷っている……？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Still, could you hurry it up? The two of
us have
a training schedule to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I said shush! At least give me time to
summon
down a UFO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh, a UFO?! With what tools?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...What a liar, that Gold Ship. Why do I
allow her
to waste my time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I won't be fooled again. I must
steel
myself in the face of her trickery.
choice_data_list: やっぱり関わるとロクなことがないな……
やっぱり関わるとロクなことがないね……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Goodness, I never should have worried
for her
in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen sighs heavily and
resolves to
stay unfazed next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But only three days later, she once again
falls
victim to Gold Ship's antics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk! Well, I suppose it's not right of me to treat you too coldly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, Gold Ship. I didn't intend to
hurt
your feelings. Would you like a pat
on the back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Should I take that nod to mean
yes?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Pet me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At times, you behave most like a child,
contrary
to your stature. And your hair is
silky soft.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How was that? Has your mood improved
now?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...More.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...All right then.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right on, McQueen! Now let's go pet a
hundred
rhinoceros beetles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rhinoce—what?! I refuse! The moment
your spirits
lift, it's more nonsense from
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is once again at the
whims of
Gold Ship, who is back to her
cheery self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But on a closer look, the relaxed
expression on
Mejiro McQueen's face
suggests that she feels
relieved.
